title: No Blast From The Past
summary:
While the movements in the oil price may resemble the
mid-1980s, the current tanker market is very different. The collapse in oil prices that we are experiencing now is not unprecedented. As a matter of fact, something very similar happened in the oil markets in 1985 and 1986.
